fem.text: The Thallids were created by Thelon, who after the Sylex Blast cultivated fungus with green mana to raise saprolings for food, and as the climate cooled many elves turned to Thallid farming.
The Thallids grew sentient and aggressive, causing an elven rift led by Morgan and Loren, and Morgan ambushed and killed Loren while the Thallids overran Havenwood in almost a day.
Sarpadia was plunged into chaos, and in the end the Ebon Hand was torn apart by the thrulls and only thrulls and thallids remained.
